title: Per-workload INT8 calibration harness and runtime kernel selector for activation-aware quantization
creator: Marcus Li
description: Build a per-workload calibration harness and a runtime kernel selector that enable activation-aware INT8 quantization (SmoothQuant-style scaling) across model families. The goal is to produce stable, reproducible INT8 profiles per-customer workload, automatically select the optimal kernel variant at inference time, and provide rollout/rollback controls when regression is detected.
acceptance_criteria: Calibration harness can produce per-model, per-workload quant profiles (scale tensors and clipping values) reproducibly from a representative sample dataset
Automatic profile generation produces <=0.8% relative degradation in downstream metric (perplexity or task accuracy) versus FP16 baseline on 80% of internal eval suites
Runtime selector chooses INT8 kernel variant or FP16 fallback with <2ms median decision overhead and keeps overall P95 latency within 5% of FP16 baseline under steady load
CI gating/test-suite that fails a PR when regression >1.5% on canonical eval set
Observability: dashboard showing per-workload calibration results, kernel selection counts, and accuracy deltas over time
design_decisions: Use a two-phase calibration: (1) lightweight profiling pass to collect per-layer activation statistics, (2) targeted optimization pass that computes SmoothQuant scaling factors and per-channel ranges
Store calibration artifacts as immutable profiles: includes per-tensor scales, quantized kernel flags, and validity hash for workload/sample set
Implement runtime kernel selector as a small policy layer in the serving runtime that reads profile metadata + live telemetry (latency, error rates) to pick kernel variant
Fallback policy: if quality regression is detected in production (>1.5% metric drop), automatically switch to FP16 or broader-range quant (e.g., 4-bit fallback) and create an incident alert
Keep calibration and runtime logic model-family-agnostic; provide model adapters for T5/LLama/GPT-style architectures
calibration_workflow: 1) User provides representative sample (n=500-2000 sequences) or selects one of Redwood-curated sample-sets
2) Profiling pass runs streaming forward-only batches to collect activation max/mean/statistics per layer (low overhead, can run on CPU or small GPU)
3) Compute SmoothQuant-style per-channel scaling factors to move activation dynamic range into weight range with L2 loss penalty on reconstruction
4) Perform calibration validation: quantize model using generated profile, run evaluation harness (perplexity / accuracy / answer-quality) against baseline and record deltas
5) If regression within thresholds, emit profile package and sign it; otherwise iterate with adjusted clipping thresholds or mark as 'needs manual review'
6) Publish profile to customer profile store with metadata: model-version, sample-hash, runtime-release, expiry-policy
runtime_kernel_strategy: - Kernel variants: INT8-activation-aware (smooth), INT8-conservative (per-channel symmetric), FP16 baseline
- Runtime selector inputs: profile metadata (expected latency delta), per-request latency budget, recent accuracy telemetry, model pin/version

- Decision rules: prefer INT8-smooth if profile validated and current telemetry stable; prefer conservative INT8 if quantization variance high; fallback to FP16 when validation fails or latency SLO violated
- Implementation: keep selection table cached per model-version; evaluate and refresh decisions asynchronously every 5 minutes or on config change
- Low-overhead decision path: selector must be a few hundred ns in hot path; heavy decisions delegated to control-plane rollouts
- Instrumentation hooks for counting selection decisions and measuring downstream accuracy impact
validation_plan: Unit tests for calibration pipeline: deterministic profile outputs for fixed RNG/sample seeds
Integration tests: quantized model inference matches golden outputs within numerical tolerance on 10 canonical prompts
Large-scale eval: run full eval suite (50 tasks across model families) comparing FP16 vs INT8-smooth vs INT8-conservative using 10k samples for each workload representative
A/B rollout experiment in staging: 10% of traffic to INT8-smooth with shadow FP16 to compute live delta; monitor quality signals for 48 hours
Performance benchmarks: end-to-end P50/P95 latency and throughput at target batch sizes across GPU instance types (A100, H100, Mixture)
rollout_plan: Phase 0: internal dev-only experiments, integrate with calibration CI and plugin to runtime (runtime-branch: quant-kicker)
Phase 1: staging A/B experiment (10% traffic) with auto-rollback on >1.5% regression or >10% latency tail increase
Phase 2: expanded rollout (50%) with manual review of per-workload calibration reports and customer opt-in for Dedicated tenants
Phase 3: GA with config flags in Console for default kernel preference and opt-out controls
Post-GA: automated re-calibration job scheduler for rolling re-profiles when upstream model weights change
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Calibration overfits to small sample leading to customer-facing regressions; Mitigation: enforce minimum sample size and require validation against held-out prompts
Risk: Runtime decision flaps causing request jitter; Mitigation: introduce hysteresis and cooldown periods for kernel switches
Risk: Increased operator burden for auditing profiles; Mitigation: provide clear UI and automated summaries in Console and a 'why-failed' report for rejected profiles
Risk: Kernel bugs in new INT8 paths; Mitigation: staged rollout, feature-flagged kernels, and safety fallback to FP16
